title: Extract Run Monitor contract and persistence
summary: Extract the immutable Run Monitor contract helpers and atomic state persistence from the oversized PowerShell state-orchestration module without changing function bodies, runtime payloads, file formats, or production command surfaces.
reason: run_monitor_state.ps1 combined schema vocabulary, validation, filesystem persistence, seed/discovery orchestration, naming projection, track evidence, lifecycle transitions, and terminal completion in one 2,418-line retrieval unit. Separating contract and persistence ownership reduces retrieval and maintenance coupling while retaining state mutation in the backend-owned PowerShell layer.
behavior_before: The module loader sourced one 2,418-line run_monitor_state.ps1 file that defined Run Monitor contract construction and validation, path/mutex identity, atomic JSON persistence, history retention, and all runtime orchestration functions.
behavior_after: The module loader sources run_monitor_contract.ps1, then run_monitor_persistence.ps1, then the 2,002-line run_monitor_state.ps1 orchestrator. All 19 moved function bodies and the complete 49-function command surface are preserved exactly; durable schema versions, payloads, paths, mutex names, atomic writes, and lifecycle semantics are unchanged.
tests_added: ops/pipeline/tests/Unit/Invoke-RunMonitorContractPersistenceChecks.ps1: direct child-module coverage for safe run IDs, evidence/progress/route construction, payload validation, deterministic membership signatures, UTF-8 atomic writes, accepted-seed reads, pointer writes, mutex identity, and bounded terminal-history retention under a disposable state root.
ops/pipeline/tests/Invoke-ReliabilityRegressionChecks.ps1: the focused child-module check is now an active all-surface reliability child.
